# OpenSSL 3.5.9 NOTICE status

A recursive query of the `openssl-3.5.9` Git tag tree found no path with basename `NOTICE`. The tag has `ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md`, included here as `TAG-ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md`; it points to OpenSSL's Thanks page and is not an Apache `NOTICE` file.

Apache-2.0 §4(d)'s NOTICE-file condition applies if a NOTICE file is included with the Work. This directory does not fabricate or relabel an acknowledgement file as NOTICE. The exact official release archive/build provenance for the bundled Windows DLLs has not been matched, so the archive's file list and notices remain an open question.

Source evidence: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/tree/openssl-3.5.9 and https://api.github.com/repos/openssl/openssl/git/trees/openssl-3.5.9?recursive=1
